abort_conditions: Any measured TCK period, high/low width or duty cycle outside the qualified rectangle; any unbounded/missing jitter policy.
Any unexpected TAP state/response/instruction, USER or configuration instruction, extra/missing clock, malformed capture, or transport disconnect.
Any workload/configuration/image change, second client, reconnect, journal write/fsync failure, or ambiguity in completion/idle state.

acceptance.jitter: Compute min/max, peak-to-peak and RMS from raw edges. No numeric PASS limit exists; Case A cannot pass until a qualified jitter limit and capture-instrument uncertainty rule are bound.
acceptance.waveform_stability: Reject missing/extra edges, non-monotonic samples, clipped/saturated captures, invalid thresholds, unstable period/pulse metrics, summary/raw mismatch, or incomplete capture.

case_a_measurement.capture: single-shot raw waveform, trigger on first rising TCK edge; 1 us pre-trigger and 20 us post-trigger; capture exactly one bounded 87-TCK scan and its idle tail
case_a_measurement.measurement_point: identified adapter TCK/SK output at the JTAG connector, referenced to the adapter ground, using the exact physical pinout for the authorized adapter revision
case_a_measurement.raw_format: Preserve instrument-native acquisition plus lossless CSV sample_index,timestamp_ns,logic_level derived using documented voltage thresholds; retain calibration, instrument/probe IDs, bandwidth, sample rate, threshold, coupling, timebase, channel and acquisition metadata.

case_b_sequence.approved_baseline_sequence: TAP reset, six-bit IDCODE instruction 0x09, 64-bit DR capture per the pinned PHK2 parser (87 TCK total), finish Run-Test/Idle; capture the same physical waveform and semantic TAP transcript.
case_b_sequence.baseline_limit: This IDCODE-only scan and adapter waveform do not by themselves prove internal BSCAN USER-branch behavior or clear the matrix's unsafe clock-interaction row.
case_b_sequence.internal_observation: Blocked pending a matrix-approved, case-bound read-only method and exact expected observations; do not guess an instruction opcode or select USER1/USER2/USER3.
case_b_sequence.routed_clock_interaction_criterion: bscan_tck bscan_tck rise-fall ... Partial Common Node Timed (unsafe)

first_requested_tck.control_rule: Do not rely on XVC settck readback. A reviewed adapter clock-control path must set this rate before the first scan; measured TCK must confirm it remains inside the envelope.

preflight_gates: Verify exact immutable qualification and TCK-envelope commits/hashes.
One-card-only signed authorization bound to FK0957, the v5.1 source/tree/route, bridge, cases 40 and 33, session nonce, expiry and operator.
Verify expected adapter serial 153300000957A and card ID 153300000957 from independent signed live evidence; IDCODE 04b69093 is family identification only, not unique identity.
Match expected historical FPGA DNA 4000000001295d813c80a445 and xcvu33p-fsvh2104-2-e; if live DNA/card mapping cannot be established before transport, refuse.
Verify exact deployed bridge ELF/build/service-config hash and effective clock-control implementation; settck echo is not proof.
Process/socket-only peer exclusion, one listener, zero existing clients, no competing XVC/JTAG process, exclusive OS lock, and signed network ACL proof; no protocol probe during preflight.
Capture backend, calibrated instrument metadata, evidence journal directory, append-only/hash-chain, fsync and rollback/recovery checks all ready before transport.

prerequisites.reason: No operator-approved signing trust root is pinned in this worktree.
Static bridge identity is pinned, but current remote process ELF/service-config identity is not freshly attested.
No instrument acquisition backend is installed; the private transport opener refuses.
Reviewed SQRL/XVC settck echoes the request without configuring MPSSE; no effective 5 MHz setter is installed.
The routed envelope explicitly marks physical jitter limit unqualified.
Historical FK0957 mapping exists; current v5.1 live card observation is still required.
The matrix requires physical TCK/BSCAN correlation; IDCODE-only evidence cannot attest internal USER-branch behavior, and no separately authorized read-only BSCAN observer is defined.
The authenticated matrix does not authorize a USER instruction; no case-bound authorization or exact USER3 transaction is pinned.

rollback_recovery.failure: Abort immediately; do not retry, reconnect, program, reset the FPGA, restart/stop services or miners. Preserve the lock and evidence; require separate authorized recovery if transport/TAP idle or image/workload preservation cannot be proven.
rollback_recovery.image_restore: No programming rollback is part of this test. Any image discrepancy is a stop-and-escalate condition for a separately authorized recovery procedure.
rollback_recovery.normal_close: Return TAP to Run-Test/Idle, stop after the bounded scan, close the single transport, verify zero sessions, seal evidence, then release peer exclusion/lock.
